title: Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Repeal Ordinance 2017

sections.shortTitle: Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Repeal Ordinance 2017
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE X OF 2017
ORDINANCE
X OF 2017
DERA
GHAZI KHAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2017
An Ordinance to repeal the Dera
Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991
[Gazette
of Punjab, Extraordinary, 21st June, 2017]
No. Legis:
13-18/2016, dated 21.6.2017.--- The following Ordinance
promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information:
It is necessary to repeal the Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority Act, 1991 (VI of 1991) so that Dera Ghazi Khan Development Authority may be constituted
under the provisions of the Development of Cities Act, 1976 comparable with the
Authorities constituted in many other cities of the Punjab inter alia for orderly and planned
growth of the city of D.G. Khan.
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab is
not in session and Governor of the Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action.
In exercise of the powers conferred
under clause (1) of Article 128 of Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:
1. Short title extent and commencement.---This
Ordinance may be cited as the Dera Ghazi Khan
Development Authority (Repeal) Ordinance, 2017.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

repeal of the Dere Ghazi Khan Development Authority

contracts entered into, proceedings commenced, rights acquired, liabilities
